title: CoderBench session label
description: One human-reviewed outcome for a corpus session. An agent never sets gradeable to true.

trace_ref.description: Corpus digest or public /trace/{uuid}. Identifies the session without embedding the transcript.

domain.description: Declared CoderBench domain this outcome belongs to, reconciled from the inventory repo hint.

repos_touched.description: Repositories the session changed or cited. Used to pick the second domain later.

issues_closed.description: Forge issue numbers this session closed. Empty when the domain has no forge.

commits_landed.description: Landing SHAs. The start-commit pin is the parent of the first of these.

outcome_type.description: What the session produced, so a suite can sample a mix rather than one shape of work.

kind.description: How the exit code is produced. LLM judges and human memory are not kinds.

command.description: Deterministic command whose exit code separates done from not-done, runnable in a container.

gradeable.description: True only after owner review: start commit builds, oracle is deterministic in a container, no corpus-unholdable credential. Agents always write false.

holdout_ok.description: Whether this outcome may sit in a holdout split. Owner sets this; drafts stay false.

owner_reviewed.description: True only after the owner has reviewed this row. Disagreements stay in notes.

notes.description: Reviewer comments, disagreements, and why gradeable stayed false.

excluded_because.description: When this session was considered and dropped, the funnel codes. Absent on kept drafts.
